tldr: Z.ai's CEO framed GLM 5.3 around a new post-training scaling law and an early hands-on review covered its pricing, but the release itself was delayed days later over disclosed cybersecurity risks.
whats_new: Z.ai's underlying GLM inference build now spans 100,000 domestic Chinese AI chips, with the company reportedly in talks to bring it to overseas cloud providers.
why_it_matters: GLM 5.3's economics are tied to a domestic-chip inference path; teams evaluating it should hold off assuming Western-GPU parity or overseas availability until Z.ai names specific providers.

status.state: Delayed, now scaling on domestic chips
status.reenable: no fixed release date or named overseas provider yet
status.detail: GLM 5.3's release slipped past its expected date after a disclosed cybersecurity risk; the inference build behind it has since scaled to 100,000 domestic chips, with Z.ai reportedly courting overseas cloud providers to host it.

beats.headline: Z.ai's CEO frames GLM 5.3 around a new post-training scaling law, as a hands-on review covers pricing
beats.summary: CEO Jie Tang explains GLM 5.3's post-training scaling-law philosophy in an AINews interview, the same day an independent hands-on review covers GLM 5's features and pricing.

beats.headline: GLM 5.3 release delayed over disclosed cybersecurity risks
GLM inference build reaches 100,000 domestic chips, Z.ai eyes overseas cloud providers
beats.summary: digitimes reports the GLM inference build now runs on 100,000 Chinese chips, with Z.ai in talks to bring it to overseas cloud providers.

open_questions: What cybersecurity risk triggered the Aug 22 delay, and has Z.ai confirmed a fix or a firm release date?
Which overseas cloud providers is Z.ai in talks with, and would hosting there still depend on domestic-chip supply?
Does the post-training scaling law CEO Jie Tang described apply to the model now running on 100,000 chips, or is that a separate infrastructure track?
take_for_builders: Hold off deploying GLM 5.3 assuming Western-GPU parity — once Z.ai names its overseas cloud providers, confirm whether that hosting still runs on the same domestic-chip inference path before committing.
